tail:
The Step 1a review is in [the append 1 report](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/frontier-44-special-representation-examples-28-alpha-step1-append-1-drift.md). It records `no-drift` for all 21 assigned A pages. The design dependencies match the canonical item dependencies, and their supplier pages are in each declared closure. I made no plan edits; the existing `plan-spec.json` change was present before this review.

`check-review` passed, as did validation of the 42 appended pages. Full `validate-plan --run` reports an order tie because the preserved batch 10 manifest still lists the KLR consumer at 1834. The canonical plan already places it at 1836, after the new supplier at 1834. The engine’s pre-apply validation passes; I left the manifest for the engine’s native SYNC.

The report records open proof obligations without treating them as missing page prerequisites or accepted results. Source checks included [Putz on bundle triangulation](https://www.cambridge.org/core/services/aop-cambridge-core/content/view/3C2209F15E20312654B3B2602314144D/S0008414X0005450Xa.pdf/div-class-title-triangulation-of-fibre-bundles-div.pdf), [de Cataldo–Migliorini on algebraic maps](https://arxiv.org/pdf/math/0306030), [Deligne’s Hodge theory](https://www.numdam.org/item/10.1007/BF02684692.pdf), and [SGA 4, Exposé V bis](https://pi.math.cornell.edu/~dkmiller/bin/sga4-2.pdf).
